wikipedia.pt: Ataque em Mogadíscio em outubro de 2017

title: 14 October 2017 Mogadishu bombings
summary: The English Wikipedia article "14 October 2017 Mogadishu bombings", at revision 1357604022, opens: "On 14 October 2017, two truck bombings took place in Mogadishu, the capital of Somalia, killing at least 587 people and injuring 316 others. Almost all of the casualties were caused by one of the trucks which detonated when the driver, while attempting to escape from security officials, crashed through a barrier and exploded in the Hodan District, destroying a hotel." Wikidata item Q42033121, whose own description reads "deadliest terrorist attack in the history of Somalia and Africa". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.
